resume_order: gate status -> open batches/Sxx.md for the open batch only
Bind every LOCAL item of the batch to a test in construction/r31/r312/Sxx/BINDINGS.json
Change only the batch's scope files (declare any extension with a reason)
Commit, then gate build --batch Sxx (or push and --import the r312-gate CI summary)
gate close --batch Sxx; commit RECEIPT.json + BUILD_SUMMARY; continue with the next batch
s00_then_s01: S00 installs HOST_SUITE.json and r312-gate.yml and records current full-suite failures; S01 makes the full suite green (Certificate fingerprint, memory admission compatibility, remaining failures). From S01 on every batch closes green.
superseded_ledgers: PROGRESS.json, EXECUTION_LEDGER.json, CURRENT_EXECUTION.json and SOURCE_CHANGE_OWNERS.json are R31.1 history (read-only, targeted queries only); progress is derived from R31.2 receipts.
claims_not_made: Android emulator or device acceptance passes
